relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work focuses on enhancing relation classification using GCN for multi-hop KGQA. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, targeting training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than improving relation classification via GCN.
